## Change

Describe the reported problem, its cause, and the resulting behavior. Link the issue.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results, including any skipped checks.

## Review

- [ ] Disclose any AI-generated changes and their remaining limitations.
- [ ] Review the fix and confirm the regression example is covered.
- [ ] Wait for the repository checks to pass before merging.

Merging and publishing a release remain maintainer decisions.
